About BLSS

Who we are, who we serve, and the Diocese we belong to.

Our identity

Bukoba Lutheran Secondary School — commonly known as BLSS — is a private, church-owned secondary school offering Ordinary Level education from Form I to Form IV. The school admits both boarding and day students, boys and girls alike, and holds firmly to its founding motto:

"In God we trust, in brain we invest, to deliver the best."

  • Full nameBukoba Lutheran Secondary School
  • Short nameBLSS
  • OwnerELCT North-Western Diocese (DKMG)
  • Registration No.S.3568
  • NECTA CentreS3491
  • LevelForm I–IV, Ordinary Level
  • Student bodyCo-educational, boarding & day
  • LocationBukoba Town, Kagera Region, Tanzania

Owned by the ELCT North-Western Diocese

BLSS is one of the educational institutions run by the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania, North-Western Diocese (Dayosisi ya Kaskazini Magharibi). Its Religious character shapes daily school life — Bible Knowledge is taught as an examinable subject, one of only a few schools in Bukoba Municipal Council to offer it, alongside French Language.

BLSS at a glance

A short visual introduction to the school and its identity.

An international friendship

Since 2012, BLSS has held a school partnership with Evangelisches Gymnasium Werther in Germany — a relationship that has brought student and teacher exchange visits in both directions, and practical support for the school.

2012

Partnership begins with Evangelisches Gymnasium Werther, Germany; a visiting delegation spends time on campus with BLSS students and teachers.

2012–2013

Fundraising by the German partner school supports water tanks and rainwater collection for the school, along with early plans for a school computer facility.

2014

A BLSS delegation travels to Germany to visit Evangelisches Gymnasium Werther, returning the earlier visit.

2018

The partnership continues with a further exchange visit between the two schools.

Academics

What we teach, and how our students have been performing.

Curriculum, Form I–IV

Students study a broad Ordinary Level curriculum across four subject groups, sitting the Form Two National Assessment (FTNA) and the Certificate of Secondary Education Examination (CSEE) at the end of Form Four.

Sciences & Mathematics

  • Physics
  • Chemistry
  • Biology
  • Basic Mathematics
  • Mathematics

Languages

  • Kiswahili
  • English Language
  • French Language
  • Literature in English

Humanities & Faith

  • Civics
  • History
  • Geography
  • Historia ya Tanzania na Maadili
  • Bible Knowledge

Commercial

  • Commerce
  • Book-keeping
  • Business Studies

News

Announcements shared with our school community, via Instagram.

31 August · @bukoba_lutheran_secondary

Pre-Form One course 2026 & Form One intake 2027

BLSS is a church school owned by the ELCT North-Western Diocese (DKMG), registered under number S.3568.

Pre-Form One Course 2026 — begins 14 September 2026 and runs until 12 December 2026.

Boarding studentsTsh 200,000
Day studentsTsh 150,000

Form One admission, 2027 — BLSS is also announcing open places for students joining Form One in 2027. The joining entrance test takes place on 12 September 2026, at test centres across the region, including:

  • Bukoba Municipal — S/M Rumuli, S/M Bukoba Vijijini
  • Kyerwa — S/M Nyakatuntu, S/M Songambele
  • Missenyi — S/M Bunazi, S/M Kyaka Ushirikani
  • Muleba — S/M Muleba, S/M Rutabo
  • Karagwe — S/M Kayanga
  • Biharamulo, Ngara, Chato and Shinyanga — respective district centres

For the full list of centres and requirements, see the school's Instagram announcement or contact the office directly.
